native.ssh_config_block:
ssh_config_block() {
  local user=$1
  cat <<EOF
$SSH_MARK_BEGIN
Host omarchy-lab
  User ${user}
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/omarchy-lab
  IdentitiesOnly yes
  StrictHostKeyChecking no
  UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null
  GlobalKnownHostsFile /dev/null
  LogLevel QUIET
  ProxyCommand /bin/bash -c 'exec nc -w 5 "\$(omarchy-lab-vm ip)" %p'
$SSH_MARK_END
EOF
}
native.write_desktop:
write_desktop() {
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$DESKTOP_FILE")"
  cat >"$DESKTOP_FILE" <<'EOF'
[Desktop Entry]
Name=Omarchy Lab
Comment=Disposable Omarchy KVM for development and PoCs
Exec=omarchy-lab-viewer launch
Icon=omarchy
Terminal=false
Type=Application
Categories=System;Emulator;
EOF
  update-desktop-database "$(dirname "$DESKTOP_FILE")" 2>/dev/null || true
}

standalone.ssh_config_block:
ssh_config_block() {
  local user=$1 proxy
  printf -v proxy '%q' "$LAB_ROOT/bin/omarchy-labctl"
  proxy=${proxy//%/%%}
  cat <<EOF
$SSH_MARK_BEGIN
Host omarchy-lab
  User ${user}
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/omarchy-lab
  IdentitiesOnly yes
  StrictHostKeyChecking no
  UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null
  GlobalKnownHostsFile /dev/null
  LogLevel QUIET
  ProxyCommand $proxy proxy %p
$SSH_MARK_END
EOF
}
